timingRuleEvidence.oldQueue: ThermalShockMod.queueServerWork is decremented on the current ServerTickEvent END before zero callbacks run; queue items created inside those callbacks are absent from the current traversal and start decrementing at the next END.
timingRuleEvidence.targetEndTask: ServerEndTickTasks.schedule inserts into PENDING; the ServerTickEvent.Post listener removes a snapshot before invoking tasks. Reschedules during endTick are processed at the next Post, not recursively in the current one.
timingRuleEvidence.warning: Only sources implementing/using ServerEndTickTasks or synchronous call sites are classified as END/synchronous. A counter name or matching integer alone is not evidence of END timing.
